Use Muse Spark 1.3 max and the full available token budget. Work from the current PR #78 tire branch, not stale main. Current evidence: moderate 0.4-steer corner = 0.845 g at 8.799 deg front slip; raw full-rack overdrive = 0.926 g; held full-rack overdrive = 0.936 g; 300-ft skidpad = 0.986 g; strict M5 validation has 0 FAIL. Peak mu and the validated B=15 pure-slip curve must not be raised or weakened without hard evidence. Previous experiments lowering lateral B and shortening lateral relaxation reduced useful cornering and were rejected. Respect AGENTS.md, PHYSICS_CONVENTIONS.md and M5_VALIDATION.md. Diagnose first, quantify before/after, and only propose a small patch when the evidence beats the current branch. Every behavioral patch needs deterministic regression coverage plus test:tire, test:cornering, test:conventions, test:m5-validation:strict, track QA and build as applicable.

Lane 13 — 30-80 km/h cornering feel. Build deterministic constant-radius/constant-speed and steering-sweep tests through the speeds most relevant to the Showcase Circuit. Find where lateral acceleration, yaw gain, front slip and understeer gradient stop feeling progressive. Separate normal usable steering from saturated over-command. Propose the smallest physics/control change that improves this window while preserving low-speed stability and skidpad.
